soft_issues: Most figures are images (1-13, 2.1-2.9, 3.1-3.21, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.8, 6.1-6.8, 7.1-7.20, 8.1, 10.1-10.4). Chart values used in claims are taken from surrounding prose, not from figure pixels.
No full author list appears anywhere in the 129-page extract. Only Ragnar Tveterås is named as project leader.

Chapter 3.4 says Karlsøy, Tromsø, Rødøy and Steigen have locality-MAB to sea-area ratios under 60 and then glosses that as high MAB relative to sea area. Later sentences treat a high ratio (Samnanger 148.57) as high MAB relative to sea area. The four-municipality gloss is internally contradictory and is not used as a density claim.
One appendix sentence on four-site capacity utilisation is unfinished ('blir kapasitetsutnyttelsen.'). No number is claimed from it.
Figure numbers 6.5 and 6.8 appear in chapter 5 where 5.5 and 5.8 are meant.
Tables 5.1-5.3 report signs only, not coefficients or standard errors.

claim_checks.claim: Industry- and municipality-funded report for BluePlanet. Preface dated Stavanger, 20 November 2023. Ragnar Tveterås is named as project leader. The preface speaks of report authors in the plural. No other author names appear on the title, preface, contents or later pages of the extract.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Ragnar Tveterås har vært prosjektleder. I arbeidet har prosjektgruppen hatt stort utbytte av møter og intervjuer med aktører i næring og offentlig forvaltning.

claim_checks.claim: The report asks whether a large increase of salmon and trout production in sheltered coastal waters (100, 200 or 300 percent, or a widely stated 5 million tonnes by 2050) is possible and sustainable. It says this is not possible with 2023 knowledge, technology and practice from egg to harvest.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Det som synes klart er at med dagens kunnskap, produksjonsteknologier og drift fra egg til slakteklar matfisk er dette ikke mulig.

claim_checks.claim: Production of salmonids is stated as rising from 150 000 tonnes in 1990 to 1 650 563 tonnes round weight in 2022. Chapter 2 also gives FAO series of 4 000 tonnes of salmon in 1980, 146 000 in 1990, 440 000 in 2000, 940 000 in 2010 and about 1 550 000 in 2022, plus about 85 000 tonnes of rainbow trout. Approved grow-out localities fell from over 1 100 to a little over 900 after 2006, while locality MAB rose from 2.1 to 3.5 million tonnes. Chapter 3 registers 1 164 localities in 2006 and 969 in 2022, and locality MAB of 2 176 681 tonnes rising to 3 521 311 tonnes.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Den totale lokalitets-MTB økte fra 2,176,681 tonn til 3,521,311 tonn i perioden fra 2006 til 2022.

claim_checks.claim: Density of localities and of live biomass per km2 is highest in areas 2 and 3. Northern areas have lower density. At the end of 2022 about 436 million farmed salmon are said to have stood in the sea, against an estimated 458 000 returning wild salmon. About one third of localities are said to be fallow at any time.
claim_checks.extract_quote: I utgangen av 2022 stod ca. 436 millioner individer oppdrettslaks, i all hovedsak i åpne merder, i sjøen langs norskekysten

claim_checks.claim: Chapter 3 is not a set of municipal case narratives. It is register analysis. Almost 300 new localities arrived after 2012 and replaced a similar number removed. Of 957 existing commercial localities, about 60 percent gained MAB (average about 2 750 tonnes). The 20 largest companies accounted for 74.94 percent of the MAB increase and about 45.37 percent of the fall in locality numbers. After 2017, Trøndelag and counties further north supplied 87 percent of national production growth. Vestland still grew 22 percent in 2017-2022 despite one or two company-MAB cuts in areas 3 and 4. Area 13 is the exception with no rise in total locality MAB. Mean distance between active sites stays about 3-5 km in most areas.
claim_checks.extract_quote: De 20 største selskapene utgjorde en avgjørende rolle i den samlede veksten, og deres økning sto for 74.94% av den totale økningen.

claim_checks.claim: Among the 20 largest farming municipalities, Flatanger and Rødøy have the highest locality-MAB per inhabitant. Kvinnherad and Austevoll barely raised locality MAB from 2006 to 2022. Samnanger is given a locality-MAB to sea-area ratio of 148.57. Træna has the lowest such ratio. The prose on Karlsøy, Tromsø, Rødøy and Steigen contradicts itself on whether a ratio under 60 means high or low MAB per km2.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Flatanger og Rødøy utmerker seg som kommuner med høyest forholdstall, noe som indikerer at tillatt biomasse er relativt høy i forhold til det lokale befolkningsgrunnlaget.

claim_checks.claim: Regressions on 2012-2022 data are reported as showing that mortality, economic feed factor and adult-female lice counts rise significantly with locality density and biomass per km2 of sea. Production cost per kg rises with area density, while cost is stable or falls with more biomass on the individual locality. Operating margin falls with area density and rises with locality biomass. The authors say economics therefore favour fewer, larger localities, while biology punishes area-level concentration under 2012-2022 technology. Tables 5.1-5.3 report signs, not coefficients.
claim_checks.extract_quote: De statistiske modellene viser at dødelighet, økonomisk fôrfaktor og påslag av lus øker signifikant med tetthet av lokaliteter og biomasse av levende laks per km2 sjøareal

claim_checks.claim: They recommend an MAB conversion scheme toward closed MAB. In the executive summary the simulated conversion factor that leaves firms indifferent sits between 2 and 5 at 10-16 percent required return. Chapter 7.1's base case is 3 tonnes closed MAB per tonne open MAB (NPV 119.09 versus 39.73 kroner per kg MAB). Sensitivity spans about 1.2 to 32 depending on cash flow, capex and required return. Chapter 7.2 says closing the 10 percent of sites with the highest lice infection pressure can raise production, cut area mortality, and double remaining open-pen operating margin from about 15 to over 30 percent, with diminishing returns after that. At a 1:1 conversion the closed-pen NPV is negative unless the long-run salmon price exceeds 100 kroner per kg HOG at a 10 percent required return.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Dermed blir konverteringsfaktoren mellom åpen og lukket MTB som gir samme kontantstrøm 3 tonn lukket MTB per tonn åpen MTB.

claim_checks.claim: Sector vetoes in locality clearance are described as producing a lowest-common-denominator outcome and slow, unpredictable siting. They want clearer sector roles, state planning guidelines that ease dispensation from old municipal plans, easier new sites and capacity in green traffic-light areas, and they want shared and inter-regional biomass caps kept. As of April 2023 no state planning guideline on aquaculture priorities existed. Company-level permit capacity and locality capacity are said not to hang together. Chapter 9.3 says locality capacity is almost four times company capacity.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Lokalitetskapasiteten er i dag nesten fire ganger høyere enn selskapskapasiteten.

claim_checks.claim: They criticise parts of the 2023 Aquaculture Committee (Havbruksutvalget) for over-central planning that ignores the Planning and Building Act's all-interests logic, and for suggesting an end to shared biomass caps across production areas without studying the extra locality need. They support removing traffic-light capacity cuts, and they support a licence-leasing idea. They treat firebreaks as having a debated biosecurity effect.
claim_checks.extract_quote: For det første mener vi at Utvalget i urealistisk stor grad legger opp til statlig styring i arealplanleggingen.

evidence_direction_note: not_applicable. The report is a mixed policy synthesis. Regressions are presented as average associations from 2012-2022 practice, not as a single causal effect claim for this room.
priority_questions_note: A1 and A5 remain core. After the full walk A2 (permit versus locality capacity, veto clearance, county process), A4 (missing cage-type data, immature closed technology, estimated pre-1999 locality counts) and A6 (ground-rent tax, municipal income, local ownership) are present. A3 is not tagged. Wild-salmon lice and environment appear, but other coastal-use trade-offs are not the object.
coi_note: Client BluePlanet. Named industry, bank, municipal and Sjømat Norge funders. Authors say they alone are responsible. Metadata records that funding.
